top_signals.title: US military needs ‘urgent revolutionary institutional change’ to prepare for modern war, Petraeus says
top_signals.summary: Ret. Army Gen. David Petraeus praised the Pentagon’s new Autonomous Warfare Command but said the U.S. must rapidly prepare for modern autonomous war.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
